scope: Three source-only physical contrast structures, each with seeds 2026092701/02/03, m1-natural single source RX and the full three-view PAMF/reference response. Main split excluded. The setting and historical target results were exposed; this is development evaluation.
motivation: The prior fixed same-packet raw/As fusion contrast improved mean cross-RX results but did not meet the >2 pp condition in all scenarios, and cross-date outcomes were worse. Investigate where the same source-only identity-preserving hypothesis is applied: in the final fusion, in each actual physical path, or in both. Prior target results are not used for checkpoint selection or to change a registered candidate; repeated use of this setting still means independent confirmation will be necessary.

candidates.mechanism: Use the prior fusion-space packet contrast in both directions: physical student against detached ordinary teacher, and ordinary student against detached mixed-view teacher. Average both directions to retain one contrast coefficient. Mixed-view teacher negatives include other accepted packets' existing mixed views, which need not all be simulated As.
Apply the same-packet physical contrast independently to each of the five actual time, frequency, PA, SIG-TIME and reference paths and average branch losses. The ordinary teacher is detached.
Apply the original fusion-space packet contrast and the average of the five branch packet contrasts together, each using the original Tri joint contrast coefficient.

shared: Use the same accepted, four-of-five branch-certified physical U slots and the same first two ordinary and two mixed student passes; no extra student forwards or new classifier. The sole positive is the same packet index; accepted packets of different pseudo class supply negatives, while same pseudo class packets are excluded. Existing Tri MixStyle can mix detached statistics of a same-pseudo-class different-day partner into both views, so this is same packet indexing rather than guaranteed unmixed feature content. Same-packet channel simulation may still affect device information. Original U pseudo CE/KL and prior source-day branch relations remain; new losses enter the existing U/L gradient guard. No U TX truth or target data are used.
initialization: Exact same-setting same-seed original Tri source-only E20, own E10+E20, fixed E50/11100 and original fixed permutation.
evaluation: All nine predictions must be frozen before independent truth-last scores; clean and six practical scenes, DURA-LU primary, DURA-L/raw secondary; cross_date separate from combined cross_rx/cross_both, matching physical IDs. Report every arm, seed, scene, TX/RX/day and paired corrections/regressions. No leo_weak, test-dependent checkpoint choice or selective reruns.
success: Aim for over 2 percentage points above PL in clean and each practical DURA-LU scene and improvement over Tri. Mean gains must not hide seed, scene, TX, RX, or date regressions; independent tests are required for general claims.
command: python -m experiments.pamf_physics_tri.publish --hybrid-contrast --repo REPO --output UNIQUE_LOCAL_ROOT --context EXISTING_CONTEXT --ssh-config N607_CONFIG
resources: N607 ordinary account, immutable release and unique run, GPU 0–7 with at most four observed/pending processes per card including other owners and conservative free-memory reservation.
stop_rule: Systemic technical failure stops new dispatch and preserves healthy workers and all artifacts. Nine actual E20 no-query smoke checks must show selected positives, different-pseudo-class negatives, and signature/reference gradients for every enabled loss.
expected_artifacts: Nine fixed E50 model trajectories and objective counters
Nine frozen seven-scene predictions then independent same-seed analyses
